newsitem.title: USA: Dyersburg plans $125 mln private placement.
newsitem.headline: Dyersburg plans $125 mln private placement.

text.p: Dyersburg Corp said on Tuesday it planned to issue up to $125 million aggregate principal amount of senior subordinated notes due 2007.
The placement was expected to be completed in late August.
Dyersburg said it intended to use net proceeds from the offering to finance part of its previously-announced acquisition of Alamac Knit Fabrics.
The private placement would be done via an offering memorandum to institutional investors under Rule 144A and other exemptions under the Securities Act of 1933.
